name: SysML v2 Studio
description: An open-source VS Code extension for SysML and KerML text with validation, navigation, editable graphical views, bidirectional text updates, and Claude/MCP integration.
editorialNote: Imported from the UMLChina SysML v2 tools collection. The English summary is a concise editorial translation; capability fields remain Unknown unless the source explicitly states support.
sourceDescriptionZh: VS Code插件，支持.sysml和.kerml文件的语法高亮、语义检查、自动完成、跨文件导航，同时提供8种可编辑图形视图。图形中的移动、连接、改名、删除等操作可以反向写入SysML v2文本，并支持Claude/MCP接口。
